versions.content: Service name: Com_MainFunctionTx Syntax: void Com_MainFunctionTx( void ) Service ID[hex]: 0x19 Description: This function performs the processing of the AUTOSAR COM module's transmission activities that are not directly handled within the COM's function invoked by the RTE, for example Com_SendSignal. Available via: SchM_Com.h
